name: common-mod
description: Claude Code mods (function hooks that draw inside the CLI and the desktop Code tab): recall — type @@ to pull a past Claude Code, desktop or Cowork conversation into the prompt, /recall for a per-project activity strata; side — /side opens a throwaway side chat beside the transcript, answered from the main conversation without touching it; bar — a two-rail status line above the prompt: folder, model and animated ctx, 5h and 7d gauges, then buttons for 側聊, 回想, diff, artifacts, the folder, VS Code, 看不懂 (/common:wait-what), 畫給我看 (/common:show-me) and 下一步 (next-step suggestions put in the prompt box as a draft).

recallExtraRoots.title: recall：其他對話紀錄資料夾
recallExtraRoots.description: 除了 ~/.claude/projects 之外要一起搜尋的資料夾，用分號分隔，例如 WSL 的 \\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu\home\<you>\.claude\projects
